answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce a new benchmark, termed SciEx (Scientific Exams), designed to evaluate this capability. ... SciEx's questions are in various formats, from multiple choice to open-ended, thus making it suitable to evaluate LLM's capabilities of generating free-text answers that fit the requirements of the questions.
answer_1.outputs: Generated free-text answers to university computer science exam questions, including explanations, proofs, and descriptions.

answer_2.quote: Therefore, we provide an automatic grading scheme by using LLM as a judge so that future LLMs can also be evaluated on SciEx.

answer_3.quote: Therefore, we provide an automatic grading scheme by using LLM as a judge ... We use the stronger models, i.e., Mixtral, Llama3 and GPT-4V, to conduct the grading.
methods: few-shot chain-of-thought grading with example selection

answer_4.quote: With expert grading, we provide a highly reliable way of evaluating LLMs ... having the lecturers grade the LLM output the same way they would grade student answers.
answer_4.guideline: Lecturers graded LLM outputs using the same criteria as student exams, focusing on correctness and quality of responses.
